expansion.intro: NOVAXIS was founded in Gabès, Tunisia, in 2009 as a physical security engineering company. Since then, it has supported governments, international organizations and industrial complexes in more than 8 countries.
expansion.item1_desc: Creation of NOVAXIS in Tunisia, specialized in physical security, networks and engineering solutions.
expansion.item2_desc: United Nations (UNIOGBIS) in Guinea-Bissau, Sri Lanka Navy and Libya's High National Election Commission (HNEC).
expansion.item3_desc: Protection of government infrastructure and electronic security for strategic infrastructure in Mauritania and Ukraine.
expansion.item4_desc: World Bank in Tunisia, IAEA/ABEN nuclear project in Bolivia and the creation of the NOVAXIS LATAM ENGINEERING subsidiary.
expansion.cta_desc: Do you have a project in Bolivia, Panama, Honduras or Latin America? We'll support you wherever you need it.
